title: Pages in floating themes — four ways the list and the frame can sit on the wallpaper

steps.path: Top bar → Pages, in Halftone Dimension, no page picked
steps.headline: In a floating theme, how should the page list and the frame sit on the wallpaper?
steps.notice: The left half of the window, enlarged, so the edges show. Look at three things: is the list its own card, is there a gap or a line between list and frame, and does the frame have gutters and corners or run to the window's edge.
steps.risk: An open page paints its own background inside the frame, so these differences show around a page and before one is picked, not inside it.

variants.label: Two cards
variants.summary: The list and the frame are two glass cards with an 8 px gap between them and 8 px gutters, matching the header pill. Ships today.

variants.label: One sheet
variants.summary: One glass card holds both; a 1 px line divides list from frame and there is no gap. Reads as a single window.

variants.label: Bare list
variants.summary: The list has no card at all: its rows sit straight on the wallpaper. Only the frame is a card.

variants.label: Edge to edge
variants.summary: The frame runs to the window's left, right and bottom edges with no gutters or corners; the list floats over it as a card with a shadow.
